definition_en: the state of having stopped work, usually because of age
core_image: 办公桌上收拾干净的相框，窗外是缓慢的午后阳光
scene: 退休以后，他搬到了海边的小城，开始学画画。After retirement, he moved to a small seaside town and began to learn painting.
sceneCN: 这里 retirement 是「退休」（第 1 个义项：因年龄原因停止工作后的状态）；句意：退休以后，他搬到了海边的小城，开始学画画。

senses.title: Leaving work
senses.definition: the act of stopping work because of age
senses.definitionCN: 因年龄原因停止工作的行为
senses.example: He chose early retirement at fifty-five.
senses.exampleCN: 他在五十五岁选择了提前退休。
senses.why: The noun names the state produced by the verb retire.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词指动词 retire 所产生的状态。

senses.title: The years after work
senses.definition: the period of life after leaving a job
senses.definitionCN: 离开工作之后的人生阶段
senses.example: She enjoys a busy retirement with her grandchildren.
senses.exampleCN: 她的退休生活很忙碌，常和孙辈在一起。
senses.why: A state that lasts for years becomes a stage of life.
senses.whyCN: 持续多年的状态就成为一个生活阶段。

senses.title: Leaving a sport
senses.definition: the end of a sports career
senses.definitionCN: 运动生涯的结束
senses.example: His retirement from tennis surprised his fans.
senses.exampleCN: 他从网坛退役让球迷感到意外。
senses.why: Athletes also step back from a long career, as workers do.
senses.whyCN: 运动员也像工作者一样，从长期生涯中退下来。

intro.en: Retirement is retire plus -ment, from French retirer, to draw back.
intro.cn: retirement 是 retire 加 -ment，源自法语 retirer（退回）。

items.en: Retirer means to draw back.
items.cn: retirer 意为退回。

items.en: Retire first means withdraw to a private place.
items.cn: retire 最初指退到私密之处。

items.en: Retirement comes to mean leaving work at a certain age.
items.cn: retirement 逐渐指到一定年龄离开工作。

items.en: It also names the years after work.
items.cn: 它也指工作之后的岁月。

items.en: Athletes speak of retirement from sport.
items.cn: 运动员也说从运动中退役。

note.en: Retirement is the noun of retire, close to resignation and withdrawal.
note.cn: retirement 是 retire 的名词，与辞职、退出相近。

entries.definition: the act of officially leaving a job

normalIntro.en: Retirement is the long afternoon after the working day of a life.
normalIntro.cn: retirement 就是一生工作日之后的漫长午后。

normal.en: Early retirement means leaving work before the usual age.
normal.cn: early retirement 意为在通常年龄之前离开工作。

normal.en: Retirement age is the age when people usually stop.
normal.cn: retirement age 是人们通常停止工作的年龄。

normal.en: A retirement plan prepares the money for later.
normal.cn: retirement plan 为以后准备钱。

normal.en: Enjoy one's retirement means live well after work.
normal.cn: enjoy one's retirement 意为退休后过得好。

normal.en: Compare resignation: resignation can happen at any age, retirement usually comes with age.
normal.cn: 对比 resignation：辞职可在任何年龄，退休通常与年龄相关。

abstract.en: Picture a desk cleared of papers for the last time.
abstract.cn: 想象最后一次清空文件的办公桌。

abstract.en: Imagine a clock whose hands move more slowly.
abstract.cn: 想象指针走得更慢的钟。

abstract.en: Think of a garden that finally gets all your mornings.
abstract.cn: 想象一座终于拥有你所有早晨的花园。

examples.en: She is saving for retirement.
examples.cn: 她正在为退休存钱。

examples.en: His retirement party was held in the garden.
examples.cn: 他的退休聚会在花园里举行。

examples.en: The champion announced his retirement at thirty.
examples.cn: 这位冠军在三十岁时宣布退役。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「retire（退休）＋ ment」——退下来之后长久的生活状态，就是退休；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 法语 retirer（退回）→ retire（退休）＋ -ment → retirement，核心义「从工作中退出后的长久状态」。

sensesIntro.en: Retirement first names the act of leaving work, then the life that follows, and finally the end of a sports career.
sensesIntro.cn: retirement 先指离开工作的行为，再指随后的生活，最后指运动生涯的结束。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cleared desk and a slow afternoon outside the window.
core.cn: 核心意象：清空的办公桌与窗外缓慢的午后。

branches.en: Leaving work is the core act.
branches.cn: 离开工作是核心行为。

branches.en: The years after work are a new stage.
branches.cn: 工作之后的岁月是新阶段。

branches.en: Athletes retire from competition too.
branches.cn: 运动员也会从比赛中退役。

branches.en: The act opens the long period of freedom.
branches.cn: 这一行为开启了漫长的自由时期。

branches.en: Both jobs and sports careers can end this way.
branches.cn: 工作与运动生涯都能以这种方式结束。

intro.en: Retirement adds the noun suffix -ment to retire.
intro.cn: retirement 在 retire 后加名词后缀 -ment。

latinIntro.en: The word comes through French retirer, to draw back.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词经法语 retirer（退回）传入英语。

items.example: Retired describes a person who left work.
items.exampleCN: retired 描述离开工作的人。

definition_en: to move back or away from danger, or a quiet place to rest
core_image: 队伍收起旗帜，沿着来路悄悄向后移动
scene: 敌军在夜色中撤退，留下了空荡荡的营地。The enemy retreated under cover of darkness, leaving an empty camp.
sceneCN: 这里 retreat 是「撤退」（第 1 个义项：因不利情况而后退）；句意：敌军在夜色中撤退，留下了空荡荡的营地。

senses.title: Move back from danger
senses.definition: to move away from an enemy or a dangerous situation
senses.definitionCN: 从敌人或危险处境中后撤
senses.example: The soldiers retreated to the river.
senses.exampleCN: 士兵们撤退到河边。
senses.why: The French source means to draw back, so retreat is a deliberate backward movement.
senses.whyCN: 法语来源意为往回拉，因此 retreat 是有意的后撤。

senses.title: Avoid a difficult situation
senses.definition: to move away from something difficult or frightening
senses.definitionCN: 从困难或可怕的事物前退开
senses.example: He retreated from the argument.
senses.exampleCN: 他从争论中退缩了。
senses.why: Physical withdrawal becomes a way of avoiding conflict.
senses.whyCN: 身体上的后撤变成了回避冲突的方式。

senses.title: A quiet private place
senses.definition: a quiet place where people go to rest or pray
senses.definitionCN: 人们去休息或祈祷的安静之处
senses.example: The monks live in a mountain retreat.
senses.exampleCN: 僧侣们住在山中的静修处。
senses.why: A place to which one withdraws takes the name of the withdrawal.
senses.whyCN: 人们退隐前往的地方，就取了「退隐」这个名字。

intro.en: Retreat comes from Old French retret, from retraire, to draw back.
intro.cn: retreat 源自古法语 retret，来自 retraire（往回拉）。

items.en: Retrahere means to draw back.
items.cn: retrahere 意为往回拉。

items.en: Retraire means to withdraw.
items.cn: retraire 意为撤退。

items.en: Retret means a withdrawal.
items.cn: retret 意为撤退。

items.en: Retreat names military withdrawal.
items.cn: retreat 指军事撤退。

items.en: It also names quiet places for rest.
items.cn: 它也指安静的休养之地。

note.en: Retreat is close to withdraw and retire, with a military flavor.
note.cn: retreat 与撤退、退下相近，带有军事色彩。

entries.definition: to move away from a place
to move back from an enemy

normalIntro.en: Retreat is a rope pulled back: the line moves away from danger.
normalIntro.cn: retreat 就像被拉回的绳子：战线远离危险。

normal.en: Retreat from battle means leave the fighting.
normal.cn: retreat from battle 意为离开战斗。

normal.en: Beat a retreat means hurry away.
normal.cn: beat a retreat 意为匆忙退走。

normal.en: A quiet retreat is a peaceful place to rest.
normal.cn: a quiet retreat 是安静的休养地。

normal.en: Retreat into oneself means become withdrawn.
normal.cn: retreat into oneself 意为变得封闭。

normal.en: Compare withdraw: withdraw is neutral, retreat often suggests pressure.
normal.cn: 对比 withdraw：withdraw 较中性，retreat 常暗示压力。

abstract.en: Picture a tide pulling back from the shore.
abstract.cn: 想象潮水从岸边退去。

abstract.en: Imagine a flag lowered and carried away.
abstract.cn: 想象旗帜被降下带走。

abstract.en: Think of a small house hidden among trees.
abstract.cn: 想象树丛中隐蔽的小屋。

examples.en: The army retreated after a long battle.
examples.cn: 经过长时间战斗，军队撤退了。

examples.en: She retreated to her room to think.
examples.cn: 她退回房间思考。

examples.en: They spent the weekend at a country retreat.
examples.cn: 他们在一个乡间静修处度周末。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（回）＋ treat（对待）」——先把自己往回带，就是撤退；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（回）＋ trahere（拉）→ retrahere（往回拉）→ 古法语 retret → retreat，核心义「向后撤、退开」。

sensesIntro.en: Retreat first means move back from danger, then avoid a hard situation, and finally names the quiet place one withdraws to.
sensesIntro.cn: retreat 先指从危险中后撤，再指回避困难处境，最后指退隐前往的安静之处。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a line of soldiers moving quietly backward.
core.cn: 核心意象：一队士兵悄悄向后移动。

branches.en: Military withdrawal is the basic sense.
branches.cn: 军事撤退是基本义。

branches.en: Avoiding conflict is retreat in daily life.
branches.cn: 回避冲突是日常生活中的退缩。

branches.en: The place of withdrawal becomes a retreat.
branches.cn: 退隐之处成为一个静修地。

branches.en: Both battle lines and arguments can be left.
branches.cn: 战线与争论都可以退出。

branches.en: Retreating to a quiet place restores strength.
branches.cn: 退到安静之处能恢复力量。

intro.en: Retreat is built on Latin re- and trahere, to draw.
intro.cn: retreat 建立在拉丁语 re- 与 trahere（拉）之上。

latinIntro.en: Latin retrahere means to draw back.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 retrahere 意为往回拉。

items.example: Old French retraire carries the word.
items.exampleCN: 古法语 retraire 传递了该词。

definition_en: to go back to a place, or to give something back
core_image: 一只鸟沿着熟悉的路线飞回旧巢
scene: 出差一周后，他终于回到了家。After a week away on business, he finally returned home.
sceneCN: 这里 return 是「返回」（第 1 个义项：回到原来的地方）；句意：出差一周后，他终于回到了家。

senses.title: Go back
senses.definition: to go or come back to a place
senses.definitionCN: 回到原来的地方
senses.example: He returned to his office after lunch.
senses.exampleCN: 午饭后他回到了办公室。
senses.why: The French source means turn back, so returning is turning one's path around.
senses.whyCN: 法语来源意为转回，因此 return 就是掉转路程往回走。

senses.title: Give something back
senses.definition: to give something back to its owner or place
senses.definitionCN: 把东西交还给主人或放回原处
senses.example: Please return the key to the front desk.
senses.exampleCN: 请把钥匙还到前台。
senses.why: An object that goes back to its owner also makes a return.
senses.whyCN: 物品回到主人手里，也是一种返回。

senses.title: Profit or gain
senses.definition: the profit made from an investment
senses.definitionCN: 投资所带来的利润
senses.example: The investment brought a good return.
senses.exampleCN: 这项投资带来了不错的回报。
senses.why: Money that comes back with more is a return on what was given.
senses.whyCN: 带着更多钱回来的，就是所投入之物的回报。

senses.title: Give in response
senses.definition: to do something for someone because they did it for you
senses.definitionCN: 因对方为你做了什么而回以同样的行为
senses.example: She returned the favor with a gift.
senses.exampleCN: 她送了一份礼物来回报这份人情。
senses.why: A favor that comes back to the giver is returned.
senses.whyCN: 回到给予者身上的人情，就是被回报了。

intro.en: Return comes from Old French retorner, to turn back, from re- and torner.
intro.cn: return 源自古法语 retorner（转回），由 re- 与 torner 构成。

items.en: Tornare means to turn.
items.cn: tornare 意为转动。

items.en: Retorner means to turn back.
items.cn: retorner 意为转回。

items.en: Return means come back to a place.
items.cn: return 意为回到某地。

items.en: It also covers giving things back and profit.
items.cn: 它也涵盖归还物品与收益。

items.en: In return marks a response or exchange.
items.cn: in return 标记回应或交换。

note.en: Return is close to come back and give back, and has a financial sense.
note.cn: return 与回来、归还相近，并有金融含义。

normalIntro.en: Return is a U-turn: you go back the way you came.
normalIntro.cn: return 就是掉头：沿来路走回去。

normal.en: Return home means go back to your house.
normal.cn: return home 意为回到家里。

normal.en: Return a book means give it back to the library.
normal.cn: return a book 意为把书还给图书馆。

normal.en: In return means as a response.
normal.cn: in return 意为作为回应。

normal.en: A return on investment is the profit it makes.
normal.cn: a return on investment 是投资带来的利润。

normal.en: Compare come back: come back is physical, return also covers giving and profit.
normal.cn: 对比 come back：come back 指身体回来，return 还涵盖归还与收益。

abstract.en: Picture a bird flying back to the same nest.
abstract.cn: 想象一只鸟飞回同一个巢。

abstract.en: Imagine a ball thrown back to the thrower.
abstract.cn: 想象球被扔回投掷者手中。

abstract.en: Think of a coin that comes back with interest.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚带着利息回来的硬币。

examples.en: She returned from the trip on Sunday.
examples.cn: 她星期天旅行归来。

examples.en: He returned the borrowed tools.
examples.cn: 他归还了借来的工具。

examples.en: The shares gave a high return.
examples.cn: 这些股票带来了高回报。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（回）＋ turn（转）」——把方向转回来，就是返回；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（回）＋ tornare（转）→ 古法语 retorner（转回）→ return，核心义「掉转方向往回走」。

sensesIntro.en: Return first means go back, then give something back, then profit that comes back, and finally a response given in exchange.
sensesIntro.cn: return 先指返回，再指归还，再指回到手中的收益，最后指作为交换给出的回应。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bird flying back along a familiar path.
core.cn: 核心意象：沿着熟悉路线飞回的鸟。

branches.en: Going back is the basic sense.
branches.cn: 返回是基本义。

branches.en: Objects also go back to their owners.
branches.cn: 物品也会回到主人处。

branches.en: Money that comes back is a return.
branches.cn: 回来的钱就是收益。

branches.en: A favor given back is returned.
branches.cn: 被回赠的人情就是被回报。

branches.en: Leaving and coming back can be a social exchange.
branches.cn: 离开与回来也可以是一种社交交换。

intro.en: Return is re- plus Latin tornare, to turn.
intro.cn: return 是 re- 加拉丁语 tornare（转）。

latinIntro.en: Latin tornare means to turn, and re- means back.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tornare 意为转动，re- 意为回。

items.example: Returnable describes a bottle that can go back.
items.exampleCN: returnable 描述可退回的瓶子。

items.example: Returned describes an item sent back.
items.exampleCN: returned 描述被退回的物品。

definition_en: to make something known or visible that was hidden
core_image: 一块幕布被拉开，后面的景象突然出现在眼前
scene: 调查揭示了一个令人震惊的事实。The investigation revealed a shocking fact.
sceneCN: 这里 reveal 是「揭示」（第 1 个义项：让原本隐藏的事情为人所知）；句意：调查揭示了一个令人震惊的事实。

collocations.zh: 一个能说明问题的细节

senses.title: Make known
senses.definition: to make a fact or secret known
senses.definitionCN: 使事实或秘密为人所知
senses.example: The report revealed serious problems.
senses.exampleCN: 报告揭示了严重问题。
senses.why: The Latin source means to draw back a veil, so revealing uncovers what was hidden.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语来源意为拉开面纱，因此 reveal 就是揭开被遮住的东西。

senses.title: Make visible
senses.definition: to show something that was not visible before
senses.definitionCN: 使之前看不见的东西显示出来
senses.example: The curtain rose and revealed a bright stage.
senses.exampleCN: 幕布升起，露出明亮的舞台。
senses.why: Pulling away a cover makes the hidden scene visible.
senses.whyCN: 拉开遮盖物，就使隐藏的景象可见。

senses.title: A divine disclosure
senses.definition: to make a religious truth known
senses.definitionCN: 使宗教真理为人所知
senses.example: The prophet revealed a message to the people.
senses.exampleCN: 先知向人们启示了一条信息。
senses.why: Religious language uses the veil image for truths made known by God.
senses.whyCN: 宗教语言用揭幕的意象，表示由神显明的真理。

intro.en: Reveal comes from Latin revelare, to draw back a veil, from velum, a veil.
intro.cn: reveal 源自拉丁语 revelare（拉开面纱），来自 velum（面纱）。

items.en: Velum means a veil or curtain.
items.cn: velum 意为面纱或帘子。

items.en: Revelare means to draw back a veil.
items.cn: revelare 意为拉开面纱。

items.en: Reveler means to disclose.
items.cn: reveler 意为揭露。

items.en: Reveal covers facts and hidden scenes.
items.cn: reveal 涵盖事实与隐藏景象。

items.en: Revelation also names sudden understanding.
items.cn: revelation 也指突然的领悟。

note.en: Reveal is close to disclose and uncover, with the image of a lifted veil.
note.cn: reveal 与披露、揭开相近，带有拉起面纱的意象。

entries.definition: to remove a cover from something
to show something hidden or wrong

normalIntro.en: Reveal is pulling back a veil: the hidden face appears.
normalIntro.cn: reveal 就是拉开面纱：隐藏的面孔显露出来。

normal.en: Reveal the truth means show what really happened.
normal.cn: reveal the truth 意为说明真实发生的事。

normal.en: Reveal a secret means tell what was hidden.
normal.cn: reveal a secret 意为说出隐藏的秘密。

normal.en: Reveal itself means become visible by itself.
normal.cn: reveal itself 意为自行显现。

normal.en: A revealing detail shows more than expected.
normal.cn: a revealing detail 显露出超出预期的信息。

normal.en: Compare disclose: disclose is formal and factual, reveal often has a dramatic image.
normal.cn: 对比 disclose：disclose 正式而平实，reveal 常带戏剧性意象。

abstract.en: Picture a curtain pulled aside on a lit stage.
abstract.cn: 想象幕布在灯光明亮的舞台前被拉开。

abstract.en: Imagine a fog lifting from a mountain.
abstract.cn: 想象雾气从山上散开。

abstract.en: Think of a letter opened after many years.
abstract.cn: 想象多年后拆开的一封信。

examples.en: The letter revealed a family secret.
examples.cn: 这封信揭示了一个家庭秘密。

examples.en: The clouds parted and revealed the moon.
examples.cn: 云层散开，露出了月亮。

examples.en: Tests revealed a small problem in the engine.
examples.cn: 检测显示发动机有一个小问题。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（去掉）＋ veal（面纱）」——把面纱拿掉，真相就露出来；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（回、去）＋ velum（面纱）→ revelare（拉开面纱）→ reveal，核心义「揭开遮盖、使隐藏之物显现」。

sensesIntro.en: Reveal first makes a fact known, then makes something visible, and in religious use means a truth disclosed by God.
sensesIntro.cn: reveal 先指让事实为人所知，再指使事物可见，在宗教用法中指神所显明的真理。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a curtain drawn back to show a hidden scene.
core.cn: 核心意象：幕布被拉开，露出隐藏景象。

branches.en: Making facts known is the main sense.
branches.cn: 让事实为人所知是主要义项。

branches.en: Making something visible is the physical image.
branches.cn: 使事物可见是具体的意象。

branches.en: Religious truth is revealed from above.
branches.cn: 宗教真理是从上而来的启示。

branches.en: Pulling back the cover shows both scene and truth.
branches.cn: 拉开遮盖既露出景象，也露出真相。

branches.en: A revelation can be ordinary or sacred.
branches.cn: 启示可以是普通的，也可以是神圣的。

intro.en: Reveal is re- plus Latin velum, a veil.
intro.cn: reveal 是 re- 加拉丁语 velum（面纱）。

latinIntro.en: Revelare means to draw back a veil.
latinIntro.cn: revelare 意为拉开面纱。

items.example: Re- marks drawing the veil back.
Old French reveler carries the word.
items.exampleCN: 古法语 reveler 传递了该词。
revealing 描述能说明问题的细节。

definition_en: money that a business or government receives
core_image: 钱币像水流一样汇入一个大池子
scene: 新产品的收入超过了公司的预期。Revenue from the new product exceeded the company's expectations.
sceneCN: 这里 revenue 是「收入」（第 1 个义项：企业或政府收到的钱）；句意：新产品的收入超过了公司的预期。

senses.title: Money received
senses.definition: the money that a company receives from its activities
senses.definitionCN: 公司从其活动中收到的钱
senses.example: The company reported strong revenue this year.
senses.exampleCN: 公司报告今年收入强劲。
senses.why: The Latin source means to come back, and revenue is money coming in.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语来源意为回来，而收入就是流进来的钱。

senses.title: Government income
senses.definition: the money a government collects from taxes
senses.definitionCN: 政府通过税收征收的钱
senses.example: Tax revenue pays for public schools.
senses.exampleCN: 税收为公立学校提供资金。
senses.why: Public income also flows back into the state's hands.
senses.whyCN: 公共收入同样流回国家手中。

senses.title: Total business income
senses.definition: the total amount a business earns before costs
senses.definitionCN: 企业在扣除成本前获得的总金额
senses.example: Annual revenue reached ten million.
senses.exampleCN: 年营业额达到一千万。
senses.why: The whole inflow of a business is its revenue, distinct from profit.
senses.whyCN: 企业全部流入的金额就是营业额，与利润不同。

intro.en: Revenue comes from Latin revenire, to come back, through French revenue.
intro.cn: revenue 经法语 revenue 源自拉丁语 revenire（回来）。

items.en: Venire means to come.
items.cn: venire 意为来。

items.en: Revenire means to come back.
items.cn: revenire 意为回来。

items.en: Revenue means income that returns.
items.cn: revenue 意为返回的收入。

items.en: Revenue means money received.
items.cn: revenue 意为收到的钱。

items.en: It covers company income and tax receipts.
items.cn: 它涵盖公司收入与税收。

note.en: Revenue is close to income and earnings, but is often total inflow.
note.cn: revenue 与收入、收益相近，但常指总流入。

entries.definition: money received from work or investments

normalIntro.en: Revenue is money coming back in: the pool fills from many streams.
normalIntro.cn: revenue 是回流进来的钱：许多小溪汇入大池。

normal.en: Tax revenue is the money a government collects.
normal.cn: tax revenue 是政府征收的钱。

normal.en: Annual revenue is the income of one year.
normal.cn: annual revenue 是一年的收入。

normal.en: Revenue growth means income is increasing.
normal.cn: revenue growth 意为收入增长。

normal.en: A source of revenue is where money comes from.
normal.cn: a source of revenue 是钱从哪来。

normal.en: Compare profit: revenue is all money coming in, profit is what remains after costs.
normal.cn: 对比 profit：revenue 是全部流入，profit 是扣除成本后的剩余。

abstract.en: Picture coins flowing into a large basin.
abstract.cn: 想象硬币流入一个大水池。

abstract.en: Imagine many small streams feeding a river.
abstract.cn: 想象许多小溪汇成一条河。

abstract.en: Think of an open door where money keeps arriving.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇不断有钱进来的门。

examples.en: Tax revenue rose last year.
examples.cn: 去年税收上升了。

examples.en: Advertising is the magazine's main source of revenue.
examples.cn: 广告是这本杂志的主要收入来源。

examples.en: The firm's revenue doubled in five years.
examples.cn: 这家公司的收入在五年内翻了一倍。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（回）＋ venue（来）」——不断回到口袋里来的钱，就是收入；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（回）＋ venire（来）→ revenire（回来）→ 法语 revenue → revenue，核心义「流回来、进入手中的钱」。

sensesIntro.en: Revenue first means money received by a business, then tax income for a government, and then total business income before costs.
sensesIntro.cn: revenue 先指企业收到的钱，再指政府税收，最后指企业扣除成本前的总营业额。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: coins flowing into a large basin.
core.cn: 核心意象：硬币流入一个大池子。

branches.en: Business income is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 企业收入是日常义项。

branches.en: Government tax income is public revenue.
branches.cn: 政府税收是公共收入。

branches.en: Total inflow before costs is turnover.
branches.cn: 扣除成本前的总流入是营业额。

branches.en: Both companies and states depend on incoming money.
branches.cn: 企业与国家都依赖流入的钱。

branches.en: Revenue measures size, not profit.
branches.cn: revenue 衡量规模，而不是利润。

intro.en: Revenue is re- plus Latin venire, to come.
intro.cn: revenue 是 re- 加拉丁语 venire（来）。

latinIntro.en: Revenire means to come back; revenue is the money that returns.
latinIntro.cn: revenire 意为回来；revenue 就是回来的钱。

items.example: French revenue gives the English word.
items.exampleCN: 法语 revenue 给出英语词形。
revenued 描述有收入的机构。

definition_en: to change something to its opposite direction or order
core_image: 一条白色箭头在灰色地面上突然掉头，指向来路
scene: 他倒车时，发现灰色的小路尽头忽然出现了一片湖。While he reversed the car, he found that a lake had suddenly appeared at the end of the gray lane.
sceneCN: 这里 reverse 是「倒车、使车辆后退」（第 1 个义项：向后移动）；句意：他倒车时，发现灰色的小路尽头忽然出现了一片湖。

senses.title: Going backwards
senses.definition: to move backwards or make a vehicle move backwards
senses.definitionCN: 向后移动，或使车辆向后行驶
senses.example: She reversed the car out of the driveway.
senses.exampleCN: 她把车倒出了车道。
senses.why: The prefix re- marks a backward movement.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 re- 标记向后的运动。

senses.title: Opposite order
senses.definition: to change the order of things to the opposite
senses.definitionCN: 把事情顺序改为相反
senses.example: Please reverse the order of the two names.
senses.exampleCN: 请把这两个名字的顺序颠倒过来。
senses.why: Turning back can also mean turning a sequence around.
senses.whyCN: 转回去也可以指把顺序转过来。

senses.title: Complete change
senses.definition: to change a decision or situation to the opposite
senses.definitionCN: 把决定或局势改为相反
senses.example: The court reversed its earlier ruling.
senses.exampleCN: 法院推翻了先前的裁决。
senses.why: A decision can be turned back, just like a car.
senses.whyCN: 决定也能像车一样被掉转。

intro.en: Reverse comes from Latin revertere, to turn back, through Old French revers.
intro.cn: reverse 经法语 revers，源自拉丁语 revertere（转回）。

items.en: Revertere joins re-, back, and vertere, to turn.
items.cn: revertere 由 re-（回）与 vertere（转）组成。

items.en: Reversus is the past participle, meaning turned back.
items.cn: reversus 是过去分词，意为转回的。

items.en: Old French revers describes something turned the other way.
items.cn: 古法语 revers 描述转向另一边的事物。

items.en: Reverse enters English as both verb and noun.
items.cn: reverse 以动词和名词两种形式进入英语。

items.en: It comes to mean the opposite side or opposite order.
items.cn: 它逐渐指反面或相反的顺序。

note.en: Reverse turns back, while invert turns over.
note.cn: reverse 是转回去，invert 是翻转过来。

entries.definition: to return to a former state

normalIntro.en: Reverse is an arrow that turns around and points back.
normalIntro.cn: reverse 就是掉头、指回来的箭头。

normal.en: Reverse the car means drive it backward.
normal.cn: reverse the car 意为把车倒着开。

normal.en: In reverse order means from last to first.
normal.cn: in reverse order 意为从最后到最前。

normal.en: Reverse a decision means cancel and change it.
normal.cn: reverse a decision 意为撤销并改变决定。

normal.en: The reverse side is the back of something.
normal.cn: the reverse side 是某物的背面。

normal.en: Compare invert: invert flips over, reverse turns back.
normal.cn: 对比 invert：invert 是翻过来，reverse 是转回去。

abstract.en: Picture a one-way arrow pointing backwards.
abstract.cn: 想象一个指向后方的单向箭头。

abstract.en: Imagine reading a sentence from the last word to the first.
abstract.cn: 想象从最后一个词读到第一个词。

abstract.en: Think of a film playing in reverse.
abstract.cn: 想象电影倒着播放。

examples.en: She reversed the car into the garage.
examples.cn: 她把车倒进车库。

examples.en: The court reversed the earlier ruling.
examples.cn: 法院推翻了先前的裁决。

examples.en: The names are listed in reverse order.
examples.cn: 名字按相反顺序排列。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（回）＋ verse（转）」——转回去，就是反向、颠倒；这只是拆词联想，与 verse（诗句）无关。

root: 拉丁语 revertere（转回）＝ re-（回）＋ vertere（转）→ 法语 revers → reverse，核心义「转回去、反过来」。

sensesIntro.en: Reverse starts with physical turning back, then moves to opposite order, and finally to changing a decision.
sensesIntro.cn: reverse 从身体上的转回开始，再引申为相反顺序，最后指改变决定。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a white arrow turning back on gray ground.
core.cn: 核心意象：灰色地面上的白色箭头掉头转向。

branches.en: Going backwards is the physical core.
branches.cn: 向后移动是物理层面的核心。

branches.en: Order can be turned around as well.
branches.cn: 顺序也能被调转。

branches.en: A decision can be reversed like a direction.
branches.cn: 决定可以像方向一样被推翻。

branches.en: The same turning motion applies to sequences.
branches.cn: 同样的转向也适用于顺序。

branches.en: Both order and decisions move to the opposite.
branches.cn: 顺序和决定都转向相反的一端。

intro.en: Reverse joins the prefix re-, back, to the Latin root vers, to turn.
intro.cn: reverse 由表示「回」的前缀 re- 与拉丁词根 vers（转）组成。

latinIntro.en: Latin vertere, to turn, lies at the heart of the word.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 vertere（转）是这个词语的核心。

items.example: Reversible describes what can turn back.
items.exampleCN: reversible 描述可以反向的事物。

latinEntries.example: Vertere is the root of many English words.
latinEntries.exampleCN: vertere 是许多英语单词的词根。
revertere 在 vertere 前加 re-。

definition_en: to look at something again in order to judge or learn
core_image: 台灯下摊开的笔记，旁边放着一支红笔
scene: 考试前夜，她坐在台灯下复习整学期的笔记。Before the exam, she sat under a lamp and reviewed the notes from the whole term.
sceneCN: 这里 review 是「复习」（第 2 个义项：为学习而重看）；句意：考试前夜，她坐在台灯下复习整学期的笔记。

senses.title: Looking again
senses.definition: to examine something again
senses.definitionCN: 再次检查某事物
senses.example: The committee will review the plan.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会将审查这项计划。
senses.why: Re- means again, so review is to look again.
senses.whyCN: re- 意为再一次，所以 review 就是再看一遍。

senses.title: Studying again
senses.definition: to study material again before a test
senses.definitionCN: 考试前再次学习材料
senses.example: She reviewed her notes before the exam.
senses.exampleCN: 考试前她复习了笔记。
senses.why: Looking again turns into study when a test is near.
senses.whyCN: 临近考试时，重看就变成了复习。

senses.title: Judging a work
senses.definition: to write an opinion about a book, film or play
senses.definitionCN: 对书、电影或戏剧写出看法
senses.example: He reviews films for a local paper.
senses.exampleCN: 他为当地报纸写影评。
senses.why: A review looks again and then judges.
senses.whyCN: 评论是先重看再评判。

intro.en: Review comes from French reveue, a viewing again, from revoir, to see again.
intro.cn: review 源自法语 reveue（再看一次），来自 revoir（再看）。

items.en: Reveue means a viewing again.
items.cn: reveue 意为再看一次。

items.en: Revoir joins re- to voir, to see.
items.cn: revoir 由 re- 与 voir（看）组成。

items.en: Videre, to see, is the deeper root.
items.cn: 拉丁语 videre（看）是更深的词根。

items.en: Review enters English as a look back at something.
items.cn: review 以「回看某物」之意进入英语。

items.en: It also means judging a book or film.
items.cn: 它也指评判一本书或一部电影。

note.en: Review looks again, while revise changes what is seen.
note.cn: review 是再看一遍，revise 是修改所看的内容。

entries.definition: to judge the value of something

normalIntro.en: Review is a second look with a purpose.
normalIntro.cn: review 是有目的的第二次观看。

normal.en: A book review gives an opinion about a book.
normal.cn: book review 是对一本书给出看法。

normal.en: Under review means being examined.
normal.cn: under review 意为正在被审查。

normal.en: Review notes means study them again.
normal.cn: review notes 意为再学一遍笔记。

normal.en: An annual review looks back at the year.
normal.cn: annual review 回顾这一年。

normal.en: Compare preview: preview looks before, review looks again.
normal.cn: 对比 preview：preview 提前看，review 再看一遍。

abstract.en: Picture a red pen moving over old notes.
abstract.cn: 想象红笔在旧笔记上移动。

abstract.en: Imagine a film critic watching a movie twice.
abstract.cn: 想象影评人把一部电影看两遍。

abstract.en: Think of a mirror that lets you see yesterday again.
abstract.cn: 想象一面能让你再看一遍昨天的镜子。

examples.en: The teacher reviewed the lesson with us.
examples.cn: 老师和我们一起回顾了这堂课。

examples.en: Her review of the novel was very kind.
examples.cn: 她对这部小说的评论非常友善。

examples.en: The case is still under review.
examples.cn: 这个案件仍在审查中。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（再）＋ view（看）」——再看一遍，就是回顾、复习、评论。

root: 法语 revoir（再看）＝ re-（再）＋ voir（看），源自拉丁语 videre（看）→ review，核心义「再看一遍并作出判断」。

sensesIntro.en: Review means to look again, whether at a plan, at notes, or at a work of art.
sensesIntro.cn: review 指再看一遍，无论对象是计划、笔记还是艺术作品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: old notes under a lamp and a red pen.
core.cn: 核心意象：台灯下的旧笔记与红笔。

branches.en: Looking again is the core act.
branches.cn: 再看一遍是核心行为。

branches.en: Study repeats the look before a test.
branches.cn: 复习是在考试前重复这一看。

branches.en: Judging follows the second look.
branches.cn: 评判紧随第二次观看。

branches.en: Both checking and studying begin with looking again.
branches.cn: 审查与复习都从再看一遍开始。

branches.en: A review looks back and then gives an opinion.
branches.cn: 评论先回看，再给出看法。

intro.en: Review combines re-, again, with the Latin root vid, to see.
intro.cn: review 由 re-（再）与拉丁词根 vid（看）组成。

latinIntro.en: The path runs from Latin videre to French voir and then English review.
latinIntro.cn: 这条路径从拉丁语 videre 到法语 voir，再到英语 review。

items.example: Vid appears in video and evident.
items.exampleCN: vid 出现在 video 与 evident 中。

items.example: Revoir brings the word into French.

latinEntries.example: Videre underlies many words about sight.
latinEntries.exampleCN: videre 是许多与视觉有关单词的基础。

definition_en: to change and improve something written, or to study again
core_image: 一页写满批注的稿纸，边角已经卷起
scene: 编辑在页边写下新的批注，要求作者修改第三章。The editor wrote fresh comments in the margin and asked the author to revise the third chapter.
sceneCN: 这里 revise 是「修改、修订」（第 1 个义项：改动文字使其更好）；句意：编辑在页边写下新的批注，要求作者修改第三章。

senses.title: Improving a text
senses.definition: to change a piece of writing to improve it
senses.definitionCN: 改动文字使其更好
senses.example: He revised the report three times.
senses.exampleCN: 他把报告修改了三遍。
senses.why: Re- plus visere, to look at, gives the sense of looking again to improve.
senses.whyCN: re- 加 visere（看）表示再看一遍以求改进。

senses.title: Studying for a test
senses.definition: to study lessons again before an exam
senses.definitionCN: 考试前再次学习功课
senses.example: British students revise for exams in May.
senses.exampleCN: 英国学生在五月为考试复习。
senses.why: British English extends looking again to studying again.
senses.whyCN: 英式英语把再看一遍延伸为再学一遍。

senses.title: Changing a plan
senses.definition: to change a plan or opinion after thinking again
senses.definitionCN: 重新考虑后改变计划或看法
senses.example: We revised our travel plans after the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨后我们调整了旅行计划。
senses.why: Any plan can be looked at again and improved.
senses.whyCN: 任何计划都能被重新审视并改进。

intro.en: Revise comes from Latin revisere, to look at again.
intro.cn: revise 源自拉丁语 revisere（再看）。

items.en: Revisere means to look at again.
items.cn: revisere 意为再看。

items.en: It joins re-, again, to visere, to view.
items.cn: 它由 re-（再）与 visere（看）组成。

items.en: French reviser carries the sense of looking over a text.
items.cn: 法语 reviser 带有通读文本的含义。

items.en: Revise first means to look at writing again.
items.cn: revise 最初指再次审视文字。

items.en: British English adds the sense of studying for exams.
items.cn: 英式英语增加了为考试复习的含义。

note.en: Revise changes a text, while review only looks at it again.
note.cn: revise 是改动文字，review 只是再看一遍。

entries.definition: to make small changes to something

normalIntro.en: Revise is to look again and make the text better.
normalIntro.cn: revise 是再看一遍并让文字更好。

normal.en: Revise a draft means improve the writing.
normal.cn: revise a draft 意为改进文字。

normal.en: Revise for an exam means study again.
normal.cn: revise for an exam 意为再次学习。

normal.en: A revised edition has been changed.
normal.cn: a revised edition 是经过修改的版本。

normal.en: Revise a plan means adjust it.
normal.cn: revise a plan 意为调整计划。

normal.en: Compare edit: edit can cut, revise usually improves.
normal.cn: 对比 edit：edit 可以删减，revise 通常是改进。

abstract.en: Picture a page with arrows and new sentences in the margin.
abstract.cn: 想象一页纸，页边画着箭头和新句子。

abstract.en: Imagine polishing a rough stone until it shines.
abstract.cn: 想象把粗糙的石头打磨到发亮。

abstract.en: Think of a second draft that is clearer than the first.
abstract.cn: 想象一份比初稿更清楚的二稿。

examples.en: The author revised the last chapter.
examples.cn: 作者修改了最后一章。

examples.en: She is revising for her history exam.
examples.cn: 她正在为历史考试复习。

examples.en: The company revised its budget.
examples.cn: 公司调整了预算。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（再）＋ vise（看）」——再看一遍并动手改，就是修订、修改。

root: 拉丁语 revisere（再看）＝ re-（再）＋ visere（看）→ 法语 reviser → revise，核心义「再看一遍并加以改进」。

sensesIntro.en: Revise begins with improving a text, extends to British exam study, and finally to adjusting plans.
sensesIntro.cn: revise 从改进文字开始，延伸到英式英语的考试复习，最后指调整计划。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a marked-up manuscript with curled corners.
core.cn: 核心意象：写满批注、边角卷起的稿纸。

branches.en: Improving a text is the core use.
branches.cn: 改进文字是核心用法。

branches.en: British students look at lessons again.
branches.cn: 英国学生再学一遍功课。

branches.en: Plans are also looked at and changed.
branches.cn: 计划也会被重新审视和改动。

branches.en: Both writing and studying involve a second pass.
branches.cn: 写文章与学习都包含第二遍过程。

branches.en: Texts and plans can both be improved.
branches.cn: 文字与计划都能被改进。

intro.en: Revise joins re-, again, to the Latin root vis, to see.
intro.cn: revise 由 re-（再）与拉丁词根 vis（看）组成。

latinIntro.en: Latin videre and its form visere give the word its seeing root.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 videre 及其变体 visere 提供了「看」的词根。

latinEntries.example: Visere is a frequentative form of videre.
latinEntries.exampleCN: visere 是 videre 的反复形式。

definition_en: the act of changing a text or studying again
core_image: 三稿叠在一起，最上面一版布满红色改线
scene: 交稿前，她把三稿叠在一起，完成最后一轮修订。Before the deadline, she stacked the three drafts and finished the final revision.
sceneCN: 这里 revision 是「修订」（第 1 个义项：修改文字的行为）；句意：交稿前，她把三稿叠在一起，完成最后一轮修订。

senses.title: Changing a text
senses.definition: the act of changing writing to improve it
senses.definitionCN: 改动文字使其更好的行为
senses.example: The essay needs another revision.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇文章还需要再修订一次。
senses.why: Revision is the noun of revise, the act of looking again and changing.
senses.whyCN: revision 是 revise 的名词，指再看并改动的行为。

senses.title: A changed version
senses.definition: a version that has been changed
senses.definitionCN: 经过修改的版本
senses.example: The revision is much clearer than the draft.
senses.exampleCN: 修订版比初稿清楚得多。
senses.why: The act produces a new version, which also bears the name.
senses.whyCN: 这一行为产生新版本，新版本也叫 revision。

senses.title: Exam study
senses.definition: study done before an exam
senses.definitionCN: 考试前的学习
senses.example: He did two hours of revision each night.
senses.exampleCN: 他每晚复习两个小时。
senses.why: British English uses revision for the study that precedes an exam.
senses.whyCN: 英式英语用 revision 指考试前的复习。

intro.en: Revision comes from Latin revisio, a looking again, from revisere.
intro.cn: revision 源自拉丁语 revisio（再看），来自 revisere。

items.en: Revisere means to look at again.
items.cn: revisere 意为再看。

items.en: Revisio names the act of looking again.
items.cn: revisio 指再看的行为。

items.en: French revision keeps the act in its name.
items.cn: 法语 revision 在名称中保留了这一行为。

items.en: Revision first names the act of changing text.
items.cn: revision 最初指修改文字的行为。

items.en: British English adds exam study to the meaning.
items.cn: 英式英语又加入了考试复习的含义。

note.en: Revision is the noun; revisionism is a very different idea.
note.cn: revision 是名词；revisionism 指完全不同的历史修正主义。

entries.definition: a small change to a text
a published version of a book
the act of making something right

normalIntro.en: Revision is the second look that leaves red marks.
normalIntro.cn: revision 是留下红色批注的第二次审视。

normal.en: A major revision changes much of the text.
normal.cn: a major revision 改动大部分文字。

normal.en: A final revision is the last check.
normal.cn: a final revision 是最后一次检查。

normal.en: Revision notes help students study.
normal.cn: revision notes 帮助学生复习。

normal.en: The revision of a draft improves it.
normal.cn: 草稿的修订让它变得更好。

normal.en: Compare edition: an edition is printed, a revision is the change itself.
normal.cn: 对比 edition：edition 是印刷版本，revision 是改动本身。

abstract.en: Picture three stacks of paper with red lines across the top.
abstract.cn: 想象三叠纸，最上面一叠布满红线。

abstract.en: Imagine a sculptor cutting away stone for a second time.
abstract.cn: 想象雕塑家第二次凿去石料。

abstract.en: Think of a path being redrawn to reach the same place more easily.
abstract.cn: 想象重新画一条更容易到达同一地点的路。

examples.en: The plan is still under revision.
examples.cn: 计划仍在修订中。

examples.en: We made several revisions to the report.
examples.cn: 我们对报告做了几处修订。

examples.en: Her nightly revision paid off in the exam.
examples.cn: 她每晚的复习在考试中见效了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（再）＋ vision（看）」——再看一遍并动手改，就是修订。

root: 拉丁语 revisio（再看）→ 法语 revision → revision，核心义「再看并改动的行为及其成果」。

sensesIntro.en: Revision names the act of changing a text, then the changed version, and in British English the study before an exam.
sensesIntro.cn: revision 先指修改文字的行为，再指修改后的版本，英式英语中还指考试前的复习。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: three stacked drafts covered in red marks.
core.cn: 核心意象：三叠布满红色批注的稿子。

branches.en: The act of changing text is the core.
branches.cn: 修改文字的行为是核心。

branches.en: A changed version also carries the name.
branches.cn: 修改后的版本也叫这个名字。

branches.en: British study before exams uses the word.
branches.cn: 英式英语用它指考前复习。

branches.en: The act and its result share one noun.
branches.cn: 行为与结果共用一个名词。

branches.en: Both changing text and exam study involve looking again.
branches.cn: 改文章与考前复习都包含再看一遍。

intro.en: Revision is revise plus the noun suffix -ion.
intro.cn: revision 是 revise 加名词后缀 -ion。

latinIntro.en: Latin revisio gives the word its shape.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 revisio 赋予这个词现在的形态。

latinEntries.example: Revisere leads to the noun revisio.

definition_en: to rise up against a ruler or refuse to accept something
core_image: 广场上的人群举起手，旗帜在风里翻卷
scene: 粮价上涨后，城里的居民起来反抗，要求罢免官员。After the price of grain rose, the townspeople revolted and demanded the removal of the officials.
sceneCN: 这里 revolt 是「起义、反抗」（第 1 个义项：起来反对统治者）；句意：粮价上涨后，城里的居民起来反抗，要求罢免官员。

senses.title: Rising against a ruler
senses.definition: to take violent action against a government
senses.definitionCN: 对政府采取暴力行动
senses.example: The peasants revolted against the heavy taxes.
senses.exampleCN: 农民反抗沉重的赋税。
senses.why: The Latin root volv means to roll, as a crowd rolls against authority.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根 volv 意为滚动，人群如浪潮般涌向权威。

senses.title: Strong disgust
senses.definition: to feel strong disgust at something
senses.definitionCN: 对某事感到强烈厌恶
senses.example: She revolted at the sight of the dirty kitchen.
senses.exampleCN: 看到肮脏的厨房，她感到厌恶。
senses.why: The mind can turn away as violently as a crowd.
senses.whyCN: 内心的抗拒可以像人群一样激烈地转向。

senses.title: A rebellion
senses.definition: an act of rising against authority
senses.definitionCN: 反对权威的行动
senses.example: The revolt was crushed within a week.
senses.exampleCN: 这场起义一周内就被镇压了。
senses.why: The verb's action becomes a named event.
senses.whyCN: 动词的行为变成了一个有名称的事件。

intro.en: Revolt comes from French revolter, from Italian rivoltare, to turn over.
intro.cn: revolt 源自法语 revolter，再往前是意大利语 rivoltare（翻转）。

items.en: Revolvere joins re-, back, to volvere, to roll.
items.cn: revolvere 由 re-（回）与 volvere（滚）组成。

items.en: Rivoltare means to turn over or throw back.
items.cn: rivoltare 意为翻转或掷回。

items.en: Revolter brings the word into French.
items.cn: revolter 把词带入法语。

items.en: Revolt first means to turn away from a ruler.
items.cn: revolt 最初指背离统治者。

items.en: It also names the uprising itself.
items.cn: 它也指起义事件本身。

note.en: Revolt is a turning away; revolution is a full turning around.
note.cn: revolt 是转开，revolution 是彻底转一圈。

entries.definition: a handgun with a turning cylinder

normalIntro.en: Revolt is a crowd rolling back against authority.
normalIntro.cn: revolt 是人群掉头涌向权威。

normal.en: Revolt against a ruler means rise up.
normal.cn: revolt against a ruler 意为起来反抗。

normal.en: An armed revolt uses weapons.
normal.cn: an armed revolt 使用武器。

normal.en: Revolt at something means feel disgust.
normal.cn: revolt at something 意为感到厌恶。

normal.en: Crush a revolt means end it by force.
normal.cn: crush a revolt 意为以武力结束起义。

normal.en: Compare rebel: a rebel acts, a revolt is the rising.
normal.cn: 对比 rebel：rebel 指人行动，revolt 指起义本身。

abstract.en: Picture a flag turning against the wind.
abstract.cn: 想象一面逆风翻卷的旗帜。

abstract.en: Imagine a wave rolling back toward the shore it came from.
abstract.cn: 想象海浪朝来时的岸边涌回。

abstract.en: Think of a door pushed shut by many hands at once.
abstract.cn: 想象许多只手同时把门推上。

examples.en: The workers revolted against the new rules.
examples.cn: 工人们反抗新规定。

examples.en: The smell made him revolt.
examples.cn: 那气味让他感到厌恶。

examples.en: The revolt spread through the northern towns.
examples.cn: 起义蔓延到北方城镇。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（回）＋ volt（转）」——掉头转向权威，就是反抗、起义。

root: 拉丁语 revolvere（翻滚回去）＝ re-（回）＋ volvere（滚）→ 意大利语 rivoltare → 法语 revolter → revolt。

sensesIntro.en: Revolt begins as rising against a ruler, then describes inner disgust, and finally names the uprising itself.
sensesIntro.cn: revolt 先指起来反抗统治者，再描述内心的厌恶，最后指起义事件本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a crowd with raised hands and a flag in the wind.
core.cn: 核心意象：举手的人群与风中翻卷的旗帜。

branches.en: Rising against a ruler is the core.
branches.cn: 反抗统治者是核心含义。

branches.en: The mind turns away in disgust.
branches.cn: 内心因厌恶而转开。

branches.en: The rising becomes a named event.
branches.cn: 起义成为有名称的事件。

branches.en: The action and the event share one word.
branches.cn: 行为与事件共用一个词。

branches.en: Disgust and rebellion both mean turning away.
branches.cn: 厌恶与叛乱都意味着转开。

intro.en: Revolt combines re-, back, with the Latin root volv, to roll.
intro.cn: revolt 由 re-（回）与拉丁词根 volv（滚）组成。

latinIntro.en: Latin volvere, to roll, explains the rolling movement of a crowd.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 volvere（滚）解释了人群如浪潮般的滚动。

items.example: Rivoltare brings the word toward French.
Revolter is the direct French source.
items.exampleCN: revolter 是直接的法语来源。
revolting 描述令人厌恶的事物。

latinEntries.exampleCN: volvere 是 revolve 与 revolt 的基础。
revolvere 发展出意大利语 rivoltare。

definition_en: a complete change in government or in the way something works
core_image: 旧雕像被拉倒，人群围着一面新旗帜
scene: 机器进入工厂后，纺织业经历了一场彻底的变革。After machines entered the factories, the textile industry went through a complete revolution.
sceneCN: 这里 revolution 是「彻底变革」（第 2 个义项：事物运作方式的巨变）；句意：机器进入工厂后，纺织业经历了一场彻底的变革。

senses.title: Political change
senses.definition: a complete change of government, often by force
senses.definitionCN: 通常以武力实现的政权彻底更替
senses.example: The revolution ended the old monarchy.
senses.exampleCN: 这场革命终结了旧君主制。
senses.why: Revolvere means to roll back; a political order is turned over.
senses.whyCN: revolvere 意为滚回，政治秩序被彻底翻转。

senses.title: Complete change
senses.definition: a great change in the way something works
senses.definitionCN: 事物运作方式的巨大变化
senses.example: The internet brought a revolution in communication.
senses.exampleCN: 互联网带来了通讯领域的巨变。
senses.why: The word moves from politics to technology and society.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从政治领域延伸到技术与社会。

senses.title: Turning motion
senses.definition: a circular movement around a center
senses.definitionCN: 绕中心的圆周运动
senses.example: One revolution of the wheel takes a second.
senses.exampleCN: 轮子转一圈用一秒。
senses.why: The oldest sense is the physical turning of a wheel.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的含义是轮子的物理转动。

intro.en: Revolution comes from Latin revolutio, a turning back, from revolvere.
intro.cn: revolution 源自拉丁语 revolutio（翻转），来自 revolvere。

items.en: Revolvere means to roll back.
items.cn: revolvere 意为滚回。

items.en: Revolutio names a rolling back or turning around.
items.cn: revolutio 指滚回或翻转。

items.en: French revolution carries the turning idea.
items.cn: 法语 revolution 保留了转动的含义。

items.en: Revolution first means a turning of a wheel.
items.cn: revolution 最初指轮子的转动。

items.en: It becomes a complete change of government.
items.cn: 它逐渐指政权的彻底更替。

note.en: Revolution is a full turn; revolt is a turning away.
note.cn: revolution 是整圈翻转；revolt 是转身反抗。

normalIntro.en: Revolution is the wheel of history turning a full circle.
normalIntro.cn: revolution 是历史之轮转过一整圈。

normal.en: The industrial revolution changed how people worked.
normal.cn: 工业革命改变了人们的工作方式。

normal.en: A revolution in medicine saved many lives.
normal.cn: 医学领域的革命挽救了许多生命。

normal.en: The wheel makes one revolution per second.
normal.cn: 轮子每秒转一圈。

normal.en: A political revolution replaces a government.
normal.cn: 政治革命更替政府。

normal.en: Compare revolt: revolt is a rising, revolution is a full change.
normal.cn: 对比 revolt：revolt 是起义，revolution 是彻底的变革。

abstract.en: Picture a statue falling and a new flag rising.
abstract.cn: 想象雕像倒下、新旗升起。

abstract.en: Imagine a wheel spinning once around its axle.
abstract.cn: 想象轮子绕轴转了一整圈。

abstract.en: Think of a map redrawn from top to bottom.
abstract.cn: 想象一张从头到尾重新绘制的地图。

examples.en: The revolution changed the country for ever.
examples.cn: 这场革命永远地改变了这个国家。

examples.en: Plastic caused a revolution in daily life.
examples.cn: 塑料在日常生活中引发了一场变革。

examples.en: The engine runs at three thousand revolutions per minute.
examples.cn: 这台发动机每分钟转三千圈。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（回）＋ volution（转）」——转一整圈，就是旋转、革命。

root: 拉丁语 revolvere（滚回）→ revolutio（翻转）→ 法语 revolution → revolution，核心义「整圈翻转」。

sensesIntro.en: Revolution starts with political overthrow, extends to any complete change, and keeps the physical sense of one full turn.
sensesIntro.cn: revolution 从政治推翻开始，延伸到任何彻底变革，同时保留转一整圈的物理含义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fallen statue, a new flag and a turning wheel.
core.cn: 核心意象：倒下的雕像、新的旗帜与转动的巨轮。

branches.en: Political overthrow is the public sense.
branches.cn: 政治推翻是公共层面的含义。

branches.en: Any deep change can be called a revolution.
branches.cn: 任何深刻变化都能称为革命。

branches.en: One full turn keeps the oldest meaning.
branches.cn: 整圈转动保留了最古老的含义。

branches.en: Politics and technology both turn the old order over.
branches.cn: 政治与技术都翻转了旧秩序。

branches.en: A wheel and a government can both turn around.
branches.cn: 轮子与政权都能转过来。

intro.en: Revolution combines re-, back, the root volv, to roll, and the noun suffix -ion.
intro.cn: revolution 由 re-（回）、词根 volv（滚）与名词后缀 -ion 组成。

latinIntro.en: Latin revolvere and revolutio give the word its full shape.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 revolvere 与 revolutio 赋予这个词完整形态。

items.meaning: a gun with a turning part
items.example: Revolver comes from the same turning root.
items.exampleCN: revolver 来自同一个表示转动的词根。

latinEntries.example: Revolvere leads to the noun revolutio.

definition_zh: 革命的；革命性的；革命者
definition_en: relating to a revolution, or completely new
core_image: 一面新旗插在旧城墙上，颜色鲜明
scene: 这种新的电池设计具有革命性，能让手机一周不充电。This new battery design is revolutionary and can keep a phone running for a week.
sceneCN: 这里 revolutionary 是「革命性的」（第 2 个义项：完全新颖、带来巨变）；句意：这种新的电池设计具有革命性，能让手机一周不充电。

senses.title: About revolution
senses.definition: connected with a political revolution
senses.definitionCN: 与政治革命有关的
senses.example: He joined the revolutionary army.
senses.exampleCN: 他加入了革命军。
senses.why: The suffix -ary turns revolution into an adjective.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ary 把 revolution 变成形容词。

senses.title: Completely new
senses.definition: causing a great change in a field
senses.definitionCN: 在某一领域带来巨大改变
senses.example: The new method was revolutionary for surgery.
senses.exampleCN: 这种新方法对手术来说是革命性的。
senses.why: A political break becomes a break with old methods anywhere.
senses.whyCN: 政治上的断裂延伸为对旧方法的突破。

senses.title: A person
senses.definition: a person who takes part in a revolution
senses.definitionCN: 参加革命的人
senses.example: The revolutionaries met in secret.
senses.exampleCN: 革命者秘密集会。
senses.why: The adjective also serves as a noun for the people involved.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词也作名词，指参与其中的人。

intro.en: Revolutionary is revolution plus the adjective suffix -ary.
intro.cn: revolutionary 是 revolution 加形容词后缀 -ary。

items.en: Revolutio names a turning around.
items.cn: revolutio 指翻转。

items.en: Revolution names a political upheaval.
items.cn: revolution 指政治剧变。

items.en: Revolution enters English as the event.
items.cn: revolution 作为事件名称进入英语。

items.en: The suffix -ary forms an adjective from the noun.
items.cn: 后缀 -ary 把名词变成形容词。

items.en: Revolutionary also means completely new.
items.cn: revolutionary 也指完全新颖。

note.en: Revolutionary describes a break with the old; radical goes to the root.
note.cn: revolutionary 描述与旧事物的断裂；radical 强调触及根本。

entries.definition: affecting the basic nature of something

normalIntro.en: Revolutionary is the adjective of a full turn.
normalIntro.cn: revolutionary 是「整圈翻转」的形容词。

normal.en: A revolutionary war fights for a new government.
normal.cn: 革命战争为新政权而战。

normal.en: A revolutionary idea changes a whole field.
normal.cn: 革命性的想法改变整个领域。

normal.en: Revolutionaries meet and plan in secret.
normal.cn: 革命者秘密集会谋划。

normal.en: Revolutionary change is deep, not small.
normal.cn: 革命性变化是深刻的，而非细小的。

normal.en: Compare radical: radical goes to the root, revolutionary overturns.
normal.cn: 对比 radical：radical 触及根本，revolutionary 强调推翻。

abstract.en: Picture a bright flag on an old wall.
abstract.cn: 想象旧墙上的一面鲜亮旗帜。

abstract.en: Imagine a key that opens a door nobody knew was there.
abstract.cn: 想象一把钥匙打开一扇无人知晓的门。

abstract.en: Think of a seed splitting stone from inside.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗种子从内部裂开石头。

examples.en: The revolutionary movement spread quickly.
examples.cn: 革命运动迅速蔓延。

examples.en: Her design was truly revolutionary.
examples.cn: 她的设计真正具有革命性。

examples.en: The revolutionaries were arrested at dawn.
examples.cn: 革命者在黎明时被捕。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「revolution（革命）＋ ary（形容词后缀）」——与革命有关的，就是革命的、革命性的。

root: revolution（革命）＋ -ary（形容词后缀）→ revolutionary，核心义「与整圈翻转有关的」。

sensesIntro.en: Revolutionary describes political revolution, then any great change, and also names the people who make it.
sensesIntro.cn: revolutionary 先描述政治革命，再指任何巨大变化，也指参与其中的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bright new flag on an old city wall.
core.cn: 核心意象：旧城墙上一面鲜明的新旗。

branches.en: The political sense comes first.
branches.cn: 政治含义最先出现。

branches.en: Any field can have a revolutionary change.
branches.cn: 任何领域都可能有革命性变化。

branches.en: The word also names the people.
branches.cn: 这个词也指参与的人。

branches.en: Political fighters and their cause share the name.
branches.cn: 政治战士与其事业共用这个词。

branches.en: Political and technical breaks are both deep changes.
branches.cn: 政治与技术的断裂都是深刻变化。

intro.en: Revolutionary adds the adjective suffix -ary to revolution.
intro.cn: revolutionary 在 revolution 后加形容词后缀 -ary。

latinIntro.en: The base revolution comes from Latin revolutio.
latinIntro.cn: 基础词 revolution 来自拉丁语 revolutio。

latinEntries.exampleCN: volvere 是这一组词的基础。

definition_en: something given in return for good work or help
core_image: 一只摊开的手掌上放着一枚发亮的金币
scene: 找回走失的小狗后，主人给了邻居一笔酬谢。After the lost dog was found, the owner gave the neighbor a reward.
sceneCN: 这里 reward 是「酬谢、报酬」（第 1 个义项：为帮助而给的回报）；句意：找回走失的小狗后，主人给了邻居一笔酬谢。

senses.title: Something given back
senses.definition: something given for good work or help
senses.definitionCN: 因出色工作或帮助而给予的东西
senses.example: A reward was offered for the missing ring.
senses.exampleCN: 有人悬赏寻找丢失的戒指。
senses.why: The word joins re-, back, with a French root meaning to regard.
senses.whyCN: 这个词由 re-（回）与表示注视的法语词根组成。

senses.title: A good result
senses.definition: a benefit that comes from an effort
senses.definitionCN: 努力带来的好处
senses.example: Hard work brings its own reward.
senses.exampleCN: 努力本身就会带来回报。
senses.why: What returns to you after effort is also a reward.
senses.whyCN: 努力之后回到你身边的东西也是回报。

senses.title: To give a reward
senses.definition: to give something for good work
senses.definitionCN: 因出色工作而给予某物
senses.example: The school rewarded the best students.
senses.exampleCN: 学校奖励了最优秀的学生。
senses.why: The noun's action becomes a verb.
senses.whyCN: 名词所指的行为变成动词。

intro.en: Reward comes from Old French rewarder, to regard, related to regard.
intro.cn: reward 源自法语 rewarder（注视、看待），与 regard 同源。

items.en: Rewarder means to regard or consider.
items.cn: rewarder 意为注视或看待。

items.en: The prefix re- adds a sense of return.
items.cn: 前缀 re- 加上返回的含义。

items.en: Reward first means to regard with favour.
items.cn: reward 最初指以赞许的目光看待。

items.en: It becomes something given in return.
items.cn: 它变成回赠之物。

items.en: It also means the benefit of effort.
items.cn: 它也指努力带来的好处。

note.en: Reward returns something for effort; a prize is won in a contest.
note.cn: reward 因付出而回赠；prize 是在比赛中赢得的奖品。

normalIntro.en: Reward is what comes back to you after good work.
normalIntro.cn: reward 是出色工作之后回到你身边的东西。

normal.en: A reward was offered for the lost cat.
normal.cn: 有人悬赏寻找走失的猫。

normal.en: Financial reward means money for good work.
normal.cn: financial reward 意为因工作出色而得到的钱。

normal.en: Hard work brings its own reward.
normal.cn: 努力本身就会带来回报。

normal.en: The school rewarded the best students.
normal.cn: 学校奖励了最优秀的学生。

normal.en: Compare award: an award is official, a reward returns a favour.
normal.cn: 对比 award：award 是正式奖项，reward 是对帮助的回赠。

abstract.en: Picture a coin shining on an open palm.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚金币在摊开的手掌上发亮。

abstract.en: Imagine a garden giving fruit after long care.
abstract.cn: 想象花园在长期照料后结出果实。

abstract.en: Think of a bell that rings back when you call.
abstract.cn: 想象你呼唤时回响的钟声。

examples.en: The company gave him a reward for his idea.
examples.cn: 公司因他的想法给了他奖励。

examples.en: The reward for patience is often trust.
examples.cn: 耐心的回报往往是信任。

examples.en: They rewarded the volunteers with a dinner.
examples.cn: 他们用一顿晚餐酬谢志愿者。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（回）＋ ward（看守、注视）」——因表现好而回赠给你的东西，就是奖励。

root: 古法语 rewarder（关注、酬报）＝ re-（回）＋ warder（看守）→ reward，核心义「回赠、回报」。

sensesIntro.en: Reward is something given back for help, then the benefit of effort, and finally the verb for giving it.
sensesIntro.cn: reward 先是因帮助而回赠之物，再指努力的益处，最后作动词表示给予奖励。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a shining coin resting on an open palm.
core.cn: 核心意象：摊开的手掌上放着一枚发亮的金币。

branches.en: A gift for help is the core sense.
branches.cn: 因帮助而给的礼物是核心含义。

branches.en: Effort itself can bring a reward.
branches.cn: 努力本身也能带来回报。

branches.en: The verb gives the reward.
branches.cn: 动词表示给予奖励。

branches.en: A gift and a benefit both return to the giver.
branches.cn: 礼物与益处都回到付出者身上。

branches.en: The noun and verb share one action.
branches.cn: 名词与动词共用一个行为。

intro.en: Reward joins re-, back, to a French root meaning to guard or regard.
intro.cn: reward 由 re-（回）与表示看守、注视的法语词根组成。

latinIntro.en: The word comes through Old French rather than directly from Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词是经古法语传入的，而非直接来自拉丁语。

items.exampleCN: rewardingly 描述某事结束的方式。

definition_en: a regular pattern of sounds or movements
core_image: 鼓面上一圈圈震动的波纹
scene: 鼓手让鼓点保持稳定的节奏，舞者跟着脚步移动。The drummer kept a steady rhythm, and the dancers moved with the beat.
sceneCN: 这里 rhythm 是「节奏」（第 1 个义项：声音有规律的重复）；句意：鼓手让鼓点保持稳定的节奏，舞者跟着脚步移动。

senses.title: Sound pattern
senses.definition: a regular repeated pattern of sound
senses.definitionCN: 声音有规律的重复模式
senses.example: The song has a fast rhythm.
senses.exampleCN: 这首歌节奏很快。
senses.why: The Greek word rhythmos means measured flow.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 rhythmos 意为有节制的流动。

senses.title: Regular movement
senses.definition: a regular pattern of movement
senses.definitionCN: 动作的有规律重复
senses.example: The rowers found a common rhythm.
senses.exampleCN: 划桨手找到了共同的节奏。
senses.why: Any repeated motion can be called a rhythm.
senses.whyCN: 任何重复的动作都可称为节奏。

senses.title: Daily pattern
senses.definition: a regular way in which things happen
senses.definitionCN: 事物有规律的发生方式
senses.example: Her days follow a calm rhythm.
senses.exampleCN: 她的日子遵循平静的规律。
senses.why: The idea spreads from music to the pattern of life.
senses.whyCN: 这一概念从音乐延伸到生活规律。

intro.en: Rhythm comes from Greek rhythmos, measured motion, from rhein, to flow.
intro.cn: rhythm 源自希腊语 rhythmos（有节制的运动），来自 rhein（流动）。

items.en: Rhythmos means measured flow.
items.cn: rhythmos 意为有节制的流动。

items.en: Rhein means to flow.
items.cn: rhein 意为流动。

items.en: Rhythmus keeps the Greek form.
items.cn: rhythmus 保留了希腊语形式。

items.en: French rithme shapes the spelling.
items.cn: 法语 rithme 塑造了拼写。

items.en: Rhythm loses some Greek letters but keeps the beat.
items.cn: rhythm 丢掉了部分希腊字母，却保留了节拍。

note.en: Rhythm is the pattern; a beat is one pulse inside it.
note.cn: rhythm 是整体模式；beat 是其中一个脉冲。

entries.definition: one hit in a regular series
the speed of a piece of music

normalIntro.en: Rhythm is the heartbeat of music and of days.
normalIntro.cn: rhythm 是音乐与日子的心跳。

normal.en: A steady rhythm keeps dancers together.
normal.cn: 稳定的节奏让舞者整齐一致。

normal.en: The song has a lively rhythm.
normal.cn: 这首歌节奏活泼。

normal.en: Body rhythm changes when we are tired.
normal.cn: 疲倦时身体节律会改变。

normal.en: Keep the rhythm means do not speed up.
normal.cn: keep the rhythm 意为不要加速。

normal.en: Compare beat: a beat is one hit, a rhythm is the whole pattern.
normal.cn: 对比 beat：beat 是一下敲击，rhythm 是整个模式。

abstract.en: Picture ripples spreading from a drum.
abstract.cn: 想象鼓面上一圈圈扩散的波纹。

abstract.en: Imagine waves meeting the shore at equal intervals.
abstract.cn: 想象海浪以相等间隔拍岸。

abstract.en: Think of a clock ticking inside a song.
abstract.cn: 想象歌声里有一只钟在滴答走动。

examples.en: The drummer lost the rhythm for a moment.
examples.cn: 鼓手有一瞬间失去了节奏。

examples.en: Her writing has a natural rhythm.
examples.cn: 她的文字有自然的韵律。

examples.en: The city has its own daily rhythm.
examples.cn: 这座城市有自己的日常节奏。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「rhythm」中间只有一个元音——把单词当作鼓点来记：六个字母，两拍落下。

root: 希腊语 rhythmos（有节制的流动）← rhein（流动）→ 拉丁语 rhythmus → 法语 rithme → rhythm。

sensesIntro.en: Rhythm begins as a pattern of sound, extends to repeated movement, and finally to the regular pattern of daily life.
sensesIntro.cn: rhythm 从声音模式开始，延伸到重复的动作，最后指日常生活的规律。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: ripples spreading from a drumhead.
core.cn: 核心意象：鼓面上一圈圈扩散的波纹。

branches.en: Sound is the first home of rhythm.
branches.cn: 声音是节奏最初的家。

branches.en: Repeated movement carries the same pattern.
branches.cn: 重复的动作承载同样的模式。

branches.en: Daily life also has a regular beat.
branches.cn: 日常生活也有规律的节拍。

branches.en: Music and motion share one pattern.
branches.cn: 音乐与动作共用一个模式。

branches.en: Bodies and days both repeat in time.
branches.cn: 身体与日子都在时间中重复。

intro.en: Rhythm carries the Greek root rhy, meaning to flow.
intro.cn: rhythm 带有希腊词根 rhy，意为流动。

latinIntro.en: Greek rhythmos passed into Latin as rhythmus.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 rhythmos 以 rhythmus 的形式进入拉丁语。

latinEntries.example: Rhythmus carries the Greek word into Latin.
latinEntries.exampleCN: rhythmus 把希腊词带入拉丁语。

definition_en: one of the curved bones around the chest
core_image: X 光片上，一排弯弯的骨线围住胸腔
scene: 他从自行车上摔下来，断了一根肋骨。He fell off his bicycle and broke a rib.
sceneCN: 这里 rib 是「肋骨」（第 1 个义项：围住胸腔的弯骨）；句意：他从自行车上摔下来，断了一根肋骨。

senses.title: Chest bone
senses.definition: one of the curved bones around the chest
senses.definitionCN: 围住胸腔的弯骨之一
senses.example: She cracked a rib while coughing.
senses.exampleCN: 她咳嗽时把肋骨咳裂了。
senses.why: The word has long named the curved bones of the chest.
senses.whyCN: 这个词长期指胸腔的弯骨。

senses.title: Meat cut
senses.definition: a piece of meat with a rib bone
senses.definitionCN: 带肋骨的肉块
senses.example: We had ribs for dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 我们晚餐吃了排骨。
senses.why: The bone gives its name to the meat around it.
senses.whyCN: 骨头把自己的名字给了周围的肉。

senses.title: Supporting strip
senses.definition: a curved strip that supports a structure
senses.definitionCN: 支撑结构的弯曲条状物
senses.example: The ribs of the umbrella are made of steel.
senses.exampleCN: 伞骨是钢制的。
senses.why: Anything rib-like can borrow the same shape word.
senses.whyCN: 任何像肋骨的形状都能借用这个词。

intro.en: Rib is an old English word, ribb, with a Germanic past.
intro.cn: rib 是古英语词 ribb，有着日耳曼语渊源。

items.en: Ribb names a bone of the chest.
items.cn: ribb 指胸腔的骨头。

items.en: The word is common to Germanic languages.
items.cn: 这个词在日耳曼语族中普遍存在。

items.en: Rib keeps the same shape and meaning.
items.cn: rib 保留了相同的形态和含义。

items.en: It also names a cut of meat.
items.cn: 它也指一种肉块。

items.en: It describes curved supports as well.
items.cn: 它还描述弯曲的支撑结构。

note.en: Rib is a bone; a strip is any long narrow piece.
note.cn: rib 是骨头；strip 泛指任何长条。

entries.definition: a hard part of the body

normalIntro.en: Ribs are the curved bars that guard the heart.
normalIntro.cn: rib 是守护心脏的弯曲栅栏。

normal.en: A rib cage protects the lungs.
normal.cn: 胸廓保护肺。

normal.en: Spare ribs are a popular dish.
normal.cn: 排骨是一道受欢迎的菜。

normal.en: The umbrella has steel ribs.
normal.cn: 这把伞有钢制伞骨。

normal.en: He broke a rib playing football.
normal.cn: 他踢足球时断了一根肋骨。

normal.en: Compare bone: every rib is a bone, but not every bone is a rib.
normal.cn: 对比 bone：每根肋骨都是骨头，但不是每根骨头都是肋骨。

abstract.en: Picture curved bars around a small room.
abstract.cn: 想象围住小房间的弯曲栅栏。

abstract.en: Imagine a basket woven from long thin strips.
abstract.cn: 想象一只用细长条编成的篮子。

abstract.en: Think of a hug that holds without touching.
abstract.cn: 想象一个不触碰却托住你的怀抱。

examples.en: The X-ray showed a broken rib.
examples.cn: X 光片上显示一根肋骨骨折。

examples.en: She cooked spare ribs for the family.
examples.cn: 她为家人做了排骨。

examples.en: The tent is held open by thin ribs.
examples.cn: 帐篷靠细长的肋杆撑开。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「rib」三个字母短促有力——像一根弯曲的肋骨，也像敲两下的短音。

root: 古英语 ribb（肋）→ 中古英语 rib → 现代英语 rib，核心义「胸腔的弯骨及其相似结构」。

sensesIntro.en: Rib first names the chest bone, then the meat around it, and finally any curved supporting strip.
sensesIntro.cn: rib 先指胸腔的骨头，再指其周围的肉，最后指任何弯曲的支撑条。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: curved bone lines around a chest on an X-ray.
core.cn: 核心意象：X 光片上围住胸腔的弯骨线条。

branches.en: The chest bone is the core sense.
branches.cn: 胸腔的骨头是核心含义。

branches.en: The meat around the bone takes the name.
branches.cn: 骨边的肉沿用了这个名字。

branches.en: Curved supports are rib-like.
branches.cn: 弯曲的支撑物像肋骨。

branches.en: Bone and meat are named together.
branches.cn: 骨头与肉一起被命名。

branches.en: Both the body and objects use the curved shape.
branches.cn: 身体与器物都用这种弯曲形状。

intro.en: Rib is a short Old English word with a Germanic past.
intro.cn: rib 是一个简短的古英语词，有日耳曼语渊源。

latinIntro.en: It has no Latin root; the word comes from Old English ribb.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，来自古英语 ribb。

items.example: Ribb is the oldest recorded form.
items.exampleCN: ribb 是现存最古老的形式。
ribbed 描述有条纹的表面。

items.example: Rib cage names the whole frame.

definition_en: a long narrow piece of cloth used for tying or decorating
core_image: 礼物盒上打成蝴蝶结的红色丝带
scene: 她把红色丝带系在礼物盒上，打了一个整齐的结。She tied a red ribbon around the gift box and made a neat bow.
sceneCN: 这里 ribbon 是「丝带」（第 1 个义项：用于系扎或装饰的窄布条）；句意：她把红色丝带系在礼物盒上，打了一个整齐的结。

senses.title: Decorative band
senses.definition: a narrow band of cloth used to tie or decorate
senses.definitionCN: 用于系扎或装饰的窄布条
senses.example: The ribbon matched the color of the box.
senses.exampleCN: 丝带和盒子的颜色很相配。
senses.why: The word comes from French ruban, a silk band.
senses.whyCN: 这个词源自法语 ruban（丝带）。

senses.title: Strip of material
senses.definition: a long narrow strip of something
senses.definitionCN: 某物的长窄条
senses.example: A ribbon of road followed the river.
senses.exampleCN: 一条带状公路沿着河延伸。
senses.why: Any long narrow strip can share the ribbon shape.
senses.whyCN: 任何细长条都能借用丝带的形状。

senses.title: Award band
senses.definition: a band given as a prize or mark of honor
senses.definitionCN: 作为奖品或荣誉标志的带子
senses.example: Her essay won a blue ribbon.
senses.exampleCN: 她的文章赢得了蓝带奖。
senses.why: Prize ribbons borrow the look of a tied band.
senses.whyCN: 奖带借用了系带的样式。

intro.en: Ribbon comes from Old French ruban, a silk band.
intro.cn: ribbon 源自法语 ruban（丝带）。

items.en: Ruban means a silk band.
items.cn: ruban 意为丝带。

items.en: The word names a fine narrow cloth.
items.cn: 这个词指精细的窄布。

items.en: Ribbon keeps the decorative sense.
items.cn: ribbon 保留了装饰性的含义。

items.en: It also names any narrow strip.
items.cn: 它也指任何窄条。

items.en: Prize ribbons are common at fairs.
items.cn: 集市上常见奖带。

note.en: Ribbon is a narrow cloth band; a strip can be any material.
note.cn: ribbon 是窄布带；strip 可以是任何材料。

entries.definition: a thin strip used to tie things
a long thin material used for fastening
a wide cloth band worn around the waist

normalIntro.en: Ribbon is a thin river of cloth tied into a bow.
normalIntro.cn: ribbon 是一条被打成蝴蝶结的细布河。

normal.en: Tie a ribbon around the box.
normal.cn: 在盒子上系一条丝带。

normal.en: Ribbon cutting marks a new opening.
normal.cn: 剪彩标志着新的开端。

normal.en: A blue ribbon is a prize at a fair.
normal.cn: 蓝带是集市上的奖品。

normal.en: A ribbon of road follows the valley.
normal.cn: 一条带状公路沿着山谷延伸。

normal.en: Compare band: a band may tie hair, a ribbon decorates.
normal.cn: 对比 band：band 可扎头发，ribbon 用于装饰。

abstract.en: Picture a red line tying two worlds together.
abstract.cn: 想象一条红线把两个世界系在一起。

abstract.en: Imagine a river seen from above as a silk thread.
abstract.cn: 想象从高处看，河流像一根丝线。

abstract.en: Think of a gift that becomes more precious with a bow.
abstract.cn: 想象一份因蝴蝶结而更显珍贵的礼物。

examples.en: She wore a yellow ribbon in her hair.
examples.cn: 她头发上系着一条黄丝带。

examples.en: The mayor cut the ribbon at the new library.
examples.cn: 市长在新图书馆剪彩。

examples.en: A ribbon of smoke rose from the chimney.
examples.cn: 一缕烟从烟囱里袅袅升起。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ribbon」两段 b 相连——像一条被反复折叠、打成蝴蝶结的丝带。

root: 古法语 ruban（丝带）→ 中古英语 riban → ribbon，核心义「细长的布带及其相似物」。

sensesIntro.en: Ribbon begins as a decorative cloth band, extends to any narrow strip, and also names a prize band.
sensesIntro.cn: ribbon 先是装饰性的布带，再指任何窄条，也指奖品带。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a red ribbon tied into a bow on a gift box.
core.cn: 核心意象：礼物盒上打成蝴蝶结的红丝带。

branches.en: The decorative band is the core.
branches.cn: 装饰布带是核心含义。

branches.en: The narrow shape extends to other strips.
branches.cn: 窄长形状延伸到其他条状物。

branches.en: A prize band borrows the same form.
branches.cn: 奖带借用了同样的形态。

branches.en: Decorating and honoring both use a band.
branches.cn: 装饰与表彰都使用带子。

branches.en: A prize band and a strip share the narrow shape.
branches.cn: 奖带与条带共享窄长的形状。

intro.en: Ribbon comes from French and takes little English affixing.
intro.cn: ribbon 来自法语，英语中很少再加词缀。

latinIntro.en: The word is French in origin rather than Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词源自法语，而非拉丁语。

items.example: Riban is the older English spelling.
items.exampleCN: riban 是较早的英语拼写。
ribboned 描述装饰过的物品。

items.example: Ribbonlike describes a long narrow shape.

definition_en: a white grain used as food, grown in wet fields
core_image: 竹筐里堆着雪白的米粒，旁边是一株稻穗
scene: 南方的水田里，农民弯腰插秧，等到秋天收割稻谷。In the wet fields of the south, farmers bend to plant rice and harvest the grain in autumn.
sceneCN: 这里 rice 是「稻、稻谷」（第 1 个义项：生长在水田中的作物）；句意：南方的水田里，农民弯腰插秧，等到秋天收割稻谷。

senses.title: The plant
senses.definition: a grass plant grown in wet fields
senses.definitionCN: 生长在水田中的禾本科植物
senses.example: Rice grows best in warm, wet fields.
senses.exampleCN: 稻子在温暖湿润的水田里长得最好。
senses.why: The word names the living plant before the food.
senses.whyCN: 这个词先指活着的植物，再指食物。

senses.title: The grain
senses.definition: the white grain taken from the plant
senses.definitionCN: 从植株上收获的白色谷粒
senses.example: The shop sells rice by the kilo.
senses.exampleCN: 商店按公斤卖大米。
senses.why: The harvested grain keeps the same name.
senses.whyCN: 收获的谷粒沿用同一名称。

senses.title: Cooked food
senses.definition: the grain cooked and eaten
senses.definitionCN: 煮熟后食用的米粒
senses.example: We had rice with fish for dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 我们晚餐吃了米饭配鱼。
senses.why: Cooked grain on a plate is the everyday sense.
senses.whyCN: 盘中的熟米是日常含义。

intro.en: Rice comes from Greek oryza through Latin, Italian and French.
intro.cn: rice 从希腊语 oryza 经拉丁语、意大利语和法语传来。

items.en: Oryza names the grain.
items.cn: oryza 指这种谷物。

items.en: Oryza keeps the Greek word.
items.cn: oryza 保留了希腊词。

items.en: Riso shortens the Latin form.
items.cn: riso 缩短了拉丁语形式。

items.en: Ris enters Old French.
items.cn: ris 进入古法语。

items.en: Rice settles as the modern English form.
items.cn: rice 定型为现代英语形式。

note.en: Rice is the grain; a paddy is the field where it grows.
note.cn: rice 是谷物；paddy 是种它的水田。

entries.definition: a small hard seed used as food

normalIntro.en: Rice is the white grain that feeds half the world.
normalIntro.cn: rice 是养活半个世界的白色谷粒。

normal.en: Rice grows in wet fields.
normal.cn: 稻子生长在水田里。

normal.en: A bowl of rice is served with dinner.
normal.cn: 晚餐配一碗米饭。

normal.en: A rice field is a field for rice.
normal.cn: rice field 是种稻的田。

normal.en: Cooked rice is soft and white.
normal.cn: 煮熟的米饭柔软洁白。

normal.en: Compare paddy: a paddy is the field, rice is the crop.
normal.cn: 对比 paddy：paddy 是田，rice 是作物。

abstract.en: Picture a white bowl filled with tiny grains.
abstract.cn: 想象一只装满细小米粒的白碗。

abstract.en: Imagine a field of green stalks reflected in water.
abstract.cn: 想象绿色的稻秆倒映在水中。

abstract.en: Think of a table where one grain feeds many hands.
abstract.cn: 想象一张桌子，一种谷物养活许多双手。

examples.en: Rice is the main food in many countries.
examples.cn: 稻米是许多国家的主食。

examples.en: They plant rice in May.
examples.cn: 他们在五月插秧。

examples.en: She cooked rice for lunch.
examples.cn: 她做了米饭当午饭。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「rice」与「rise（升起）」只差一个字母——稻子在水田里一天天长高。

root: 希腊语 oryza（稻米）→ 拉丁语 oryza → 意大利语 riso → 古法语 ris → rice。

sensesIntro.en: Rice names the plant, the grain, and the cooked food in turn.
sensesIntro.cn: rice 依次指稻株、大米和米饭。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: white grains in a bamboo basket beside a rice stalk.
core.cn: 核心意象：竹筐里的白米与旁边的稻穗。

branches.en: The plant is the starting sense.
branches.cn: 稻株是起始含义。

branches.en: The harvested grain keeps the name.
branches.cn: 收获的谷粒沿用这个名字。

branches.en: Cooked rice is the food on the table.
branches.cn: 米饭是桌上的食物。

branches.en: Plant and grain are one crop.
branches.cn: 植株与谷粒是同一作物。

branches.en: The grain becomes food after cooking.
branches.cn: 谷粒煮熟后成为食物。

intro.en: Rice comes from Greek through Latin, Italian and French.
intro.cn: rice 从希腊语经拉丁语、意大利语和法语传来。

latinIntro.en: Latin oryza is the pivot between Greek and the modern forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 oryza 是希腊语与现代形式之间的枢纽。

items.example: Ris is the Old French form.
A ricer presses food into rice-like pieces.
items.exampleCN: 压泥器把食物压成米粒状。
ricey 描述类似米的味道。

latinEntries.example: Oryza passes from Greek into Latin.
latinEntries.exampleCN: oryza 从希腊语进入拉丁语。

definition_en: having a lot of money or containing a lot of something
core_image: 金色麦田里沉甸甸的麦穗
scene: 这里的土壤肥沃，雨水充足，庄稼长得格外茂盛。The soil here is rich, the rain is plentiful, and the crops grow especially well.
sceneCN: 这里 rich 是「肥沃的、丰富的」（第 2 个义项：含有大量有益成分）；句意：这里的土壤肥沃，雨水充足，庄稼长得格外茂盛。

senses.title: Wealthy
senses.definition: having a lot of money
senses.definitionCN: 拥有大量钱财
senses.example: The rich merchant built a large house.
senses.exampleCN: 这位富商建了一座大房子。
senses.why: The oldest sense is having great wealth.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的含义是拥有大量财富。

senses.title: Full of something
senses.definition: containing a lot of something good
senses.definitionCN: 含有大量有益成分
senses.example: The valley has rich soil.
senses.exampleCN: 这个山谷土壤肥沃。
senses.why: Wealth extends from money to any good supply.
senses.whyCN: 财富的含义从金钱延伸到任何充足的资源。

senses.title: Strong in taste
senses.definition: having a strong, full flavor
senses.definitionCN: 味道浓烈饱满
senses.example: The cake is rich in butter and cream.
senses.exampleCN: 这蛋糕黄油和奶油味很浓。
senses.why: A full supply makes food taste full too.
senses.whyCN: 充足的原料让食物味道也饱满。

intro.en: Rich is an old English word from a Germanic root meaning powerful.
intro.cn: rich 是古英语词，来自意为「有权势」的日耳曼词根。

items.en: Rice means powerful or wealthy.
items.cn: rice 意为有权势的或富有的。

items.en: The root is linked to rulers.
items.cn: 这个词根与统治者有关。

items.en: Rex, king, is a distant relative.
items.cn: 拉丁语 rex（国王）是远亲。

items.en: Rich first means powerful and then wealthy.
items.cn: rich 先指有权势，再指富有。

items.en: It also means full of something.
items.cn: 它也指充满某物。

note.en: Rich is about having much; wealthy stresses money and property.
note.cn: rich 强调拥有得多；wealthy 更强调钱财与财产。

entries.definition: in a full or generous way

normalIntro.en: Rich is a field heavy with grain and a pocket full of coins.
normalIntro.cn: rich 是沉甸甸的麦田与装满硬币的口袋。

normal.en: Rich soil grows strong crops.
normal.cn: 肥沃的土壤长出茁壮的庄稼。

normal.en: The rich often give to charities.
normal.cn: 富人常常捐助慈善。

normal.en: Rich flavor means a strong taste.
normal.cn: rich flavor 意为浓郁的味道。

normal.en: A country rich in oil has much oil.
normal.cn: a country rich in oil 是石油丰富的国家。

normal.en: Compare wealthy: wealthy stresses money, rich can mean full of anything.
normal.cn: 对比 wealthy：wealthy 强调钱财，rich 可指充满任何东西。

abstract.en: Picture a wheat field bending under its own weight.
abstract.cn: 想象麦田因麦穗沉重而弯下。

abstract.en: Imagine a cup filled to the very edge.
abstract.cn: 想象一只倒到杯口的杯子。

abstract.en: Think of a voice that fills a whole hall.
abstract.cn: 想象一个充满整个大厅的声音。

examples.en: He grew rich through hard work.
examples.cn: 他靠努力工作富了起来。

examples.en: The region is rich in minerals.
examples.cn: 这个地区矿产丰富。

examples.en: This soup has a rich flavor.
examples.cn: 这汤味道浓郁。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「rich」四个字母——r 像饱满的麦穗，ich 读来厚实，像装满的口袋。

root: 古英语 rice（有权势的、富有的）→ rich，核心义「拥有很多、内容充足」。

sensesIntro.en: Rich starts with wealth, extends to any abundant supply, and then to full flavor.
sensesIntro.cn: rich 从财富开始，延伸到任何充足的供给，再指浓郁的味道。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a golden wheat field heavy with grain.
core.cn: 核心意象：麦穗沉甸甸的金色麦田。

branches.en: Wealth is the oldest sense.
branches.cn: 财富是最古老的含义。

branches.en: Any good supply counts as richness.
branches.cn: 任何充足的资源都算丰富。

branches.en: Food with full ingredients tastes rich.
branches.cn: 原料充足的食物味道浓郁。

branches.en: Money and soil are both forms of plenty.
branches.cn: 金钱与土壤都是丰足的形式。

branches.en: A full supply makes a full taste.
branches.cn: 充足的供给带来饱满的味道。

intro.en: Rich is an old English adjective from a Germanic root.
intro.cn: rich 是来自日耳曼词根的古英语形容词。

latinIntro.en: Latin rex, king, is a distant cousin of the root.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 rex（国王）是这个词根的远亲。

items.example: Rice is the oldest recorded form.
items.exampleCN: rice 是现存最古老的形式。
rikja 把财富与权力联系起来。

latinEntries.example: Rex is related to the Germanic root.
latinEntries.exampleCN: rex 与这个日耳曼词根有亲缘关系。

definition_en: to remove something unwanted
core_image: 一只抖落雨水的狗，水珠四散
scene: 他终于清掉了阁楼里堆积多年的旧箱子。He finally got rid of the old boxes that had piled up in the attic for years.
sceneCN: 这里 rid 是「清除、摆脱」（第 1 个义项：去掉不想要的东西）；句意：他终于清掉了阁楼里堆积多年的旧箱子。

senses.title: Freeing yourself
senses.definition: to make yourself free of something unwanted
senses.definitionCN: 使自己摆脱不想要的东西
senses.example: She was glad to be rid of the cold.
senses.exampleCN: 她很庆幸感冒好了。
senses.why: The word means to clear away what troubles you.
senses.whyCN: 这个词意为清除困扰你的东西。

senses.title: Removing an object
senses.definition: to remove a thing that is no longer wanted
senses.definitionCN: 把不再需要的东西移走
senses.example: We rid the garden of weeds.
senses.exampleCN: 我们清除了花园里的杂草。
senses.why: The same act applies to things as well as feelings.
senses.whyCN: 同样的行为也适用于物品和感受。

senses.title: In get rid of
senses.definition: used in get rid of to mean discard
senses.definitionCN: 用于 get rid of，表示丢弃
senses.example: He got rid of his old bicycle.
senses.exampleCN: 他把旧自行车处理掉了。
senses.why: The fixed phrase keeps the word alive in daily speech.
senses.whyCN: 这个固定短语让这个词在日常口语中保持活力。

intro.en: Rid comes from Old Norse ryðja, to clear land.
intro.cn: rid 源自古诺尔斯语 ryðja（清理土地）。

items.en: Ryðja means to clear land.
items.cn: ryðja 意为清理土地。

items.en: The word enters northern English speech.
items.cn: 这个词进入英格兰北部的语言。

items.en: Rid first means to clear a place.
items.cn: rid 最初指清理一个地方。

items.en: It extends to clearing away unwanted things.
items.cn: 它延伸到清除不想要的东西。

items.en: The phrase get rid of is very common.
items.cn: 短语 get rid of 非常常用。

note.en: Rid means to clear away; remove is the general word.
note.cn: rid 意为清除；remove 是更通用的词。

entries.definition: the act of getting rid of something

normalIntro.en: Rid is sweeping the floor until nothing unwanted remains.
normalIntro.cn: rid 是把地扫到不留一点多余之物的动作。

normal.en: Get rid of means throw away or free yourself.
normal.cn: get rid of 意为扔掉或摆脱。

normal.en: Be rid of a cold means no longer have it.
normal.cn: be rid of a cold 意为感冒好了。

normal.en: Rid the room of dust means clean it.
normal.cn: rid the room of dust 意为打扫房间。

normal.en: Rid oneself of fear means overcome it.
normal.cn: rid oneself of fear 意为克服恐惧。

normal.en: Compare remove: remove is neutral, rid implies something unwanted.
normal.cn: 对比 remove：remove 是中性的，rid 暗含不想要的东西。

abstract.en: Picture a dog shaking rain from its fur.
abstract.cn: 想象一只狗抖落毛上的雨水。

abstract.en: Imagine an attic emptied of old boxes.
abstract.cn: 想象清空了旧箱子的阁楼。

abstract.en: Think of a window opened to let smoke out.
abstract.cn: 想象打开窗户让烟散出去。

examples.en: We must get rid of this old sofa.
examples.cn: 我们必须处理掉这张旧沙发。

examples.en: She was rid of the headache by noon.
examples.cn: 到中午她的头痛就好了。

examples.en: They rid the field of stones.
examples.cn: 他们清除了田里的石头。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「rid」短得像一声「去掉」——一挥手，不想要的东西就没了。

root: 古诺尔斯语 ryðja（清理土地）→ 中古英语 ridden → rid，核心义「清除、使摆脱」。

sensesIntro.en: Rid means to free yourself of something unwanted, to clear objects away, and to discard in the fixed phrase get rid of.
sensesIntro.cn: rid 指摆脱不想要的东西、清除物品，以及在固定短语 get rid of 中表示丢弃。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a dog shaking rainwater from its fur.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只抖落雨水的狗。

branches.en: Freeing yourself is the core sense.
branches.cn: 使自己摆脱是核心含义。

branches.en: Objects can be cleared away too.
branches.cn: 物品也能被清除。

branches.en: The fixed phrase names discarding.
branches.cn: 固定短语表示丢弃。

branches.en: Feelings and objects are both cleared.
branches.cn: 感受与物品都能被清除。

branches.en: Emotional and physical clearing share the phrase.
branches.cn: 情感与实物的清除共用这一短语。

intro.en: Rid comes from Old Norse and has few English affixes.
intro.cn: rid 来自古诺尔斯语，英语中很少再加词缀。

latinIntro.en: It has no Latin root; Old Norse ryðja is the source.
latinIntro.cn: 它没有拉丁词根；古诺尔斯语 ryðja 是来源。

items.example: Rids is the third person form.

items.exampleCN: riddance 保留在 good riddance 中。

definition_en: to sit on and control a horse, bicycle, or vehicle
core_image: 夕阳下，一个人骑着自行车沿河岸前行
scene: 每个周末，他都骑车沿着河岸走很远。Every weekend, he rides his bicycle a long way along the river.
sceneCN: 这里 ride 是「骑（自行车）」（第 1 个义项：骑乘并控制交通工具或动物）；句意：每个周末，他都骑车沿着河岸走很远。

senses.title: On an animal or bike
senses.definition: to sit on and control a horse or bicycle
senses.definitionCN: 骑在马上或车上并加以控制
senses.example: She learned to ride a horse at six.
senses.exampleCN: 她六岁学会骑马。
senses.why: The oldest sense is sitting on a moving animal.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的含义是骑在移动的动物上。

senses.title: In a vehicle
senses.definition: to travel in a car, bus or train
senses.definitionCN: 乘坐汽车、公交车或火车
senses.example: He rides the bus to work.
senses.exampleCN: 他乘公交车上班。
senses.why: The rider becomes a passenger in a vehicle.
senses.whyCN: 骑乘者变成了车辆中的乘客。

senses.title: A journey or attraction
senses.definition: a trip on an animal or vehicle, or a machine at a fair
senses.definitionCN: 骑乘动物的行程、乘车之旅或游乐设施
senses.example: The children loved the roller coaster ride.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们很喜欢坐过山车。
senses.why: The verb's action becomes a named experience.
senses.whyCN: 动词的行为变成了有名称的体验。

intro.en: Ride comes from Old English ridan, from a Germanic root.
intro.cn: ride 源自古英语 ridan，来自日耳曼词根。

items.en: Ridan means to ride.
items.cn: ridan 意为骑。

items.en: The word is shared by Germanic languages.
items.cn: 这个词在日耳曼语族中通用。

items.en: Ride keeps the horse sense.
items.cn: ride 保留了骑马的含义。

items.en: It extends to buses and trains.
items.cn: 它延伸到公交车和火车。

items.en: A ride also names an amusement.
items.cn: a ride 也指一种游乐设施。

note.en: Ride is sitting on and controlling; drive controls a vehicle from inside.
note.cn: ride 是骑在上面并控制；drive 是在车内驾驶。

entries.definition: to go from place to place
a trip from one place to another

normalIntro.en: Ride is the body moving with a horse, a bike or a bus.
normalIntro.cn: ride 是身体随马、自行车或公交车一起前行。

normal.en: Ride a bike means control it with your hands and feet.
normal.cn: ride a bike 意为用手脚控制自行车。

normal.en: Ride the bus means travel as a passenger.
normal.cn: ride the bus 意为作为乘客出行。

normal.en: Give someone a ride means take them in your car.
normal.cn: give someone a ride 意为开车捎带某人。

normal.en: A roller coaster ride is a fairground experience.
normal.cn: a roller coaster ride 是游乐场体验。

normal.en: Compare drive: you ride a bike but drive a car.
normal.cn: 对比 drive：你 ride 自行车，但 drive 汽车。

abstract.en: Picture a bicycle moving along a river at sunset.
abstract.cn: 想象夕阳下一辆自行车沿河前行。

abstract.en: Imagine a horse and rider moving as one shape.
abstract.cn: 想象马与骑手合成一个移动的轮廓。

abstract.en: Think of a road that carries you without effort.
abstract.cn: 想象一条毫不费力就能带你前行的路。

examples.en: He rides his bike to school.
examples.cn: 他骑自行车上学。

examples.en: We rode the train through the mountains.
examples.cn: 我们乘火车穿过群山。

examples.en: The ferry ride took an hour.
examples.cn: 乘渡船用了一个小时。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ride」与「road（路）」读音接近——上路骑行，就是 ride。

root: 古英语 ridan（骑）→ 中古英语 riden → ride，核心义「骑乘并前进」。

sensesIntro.en: Ride begins with controlling a horse or bicycle, extends to travelling in a vehicle, and ends as a named journey or attraction.
sensesIntro.cn: ride 从控制马或自行车开始，延伸到乘车出行，最后指有名称的旅程或游乐设施。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cyclist moving along a river at sunset.
core.cn: 核心意象：夕阳下沿河骑行的身影。

branches.en: Riding an animal is the oldest sense.
branches.cn: 骑动物是最古老的含义。

branches.en: A passenger also rides a vehicle.
branches.cn: 乘客也 ride 车辆。

branches.en: The trip becomes a named ride.
branches.cn: 行程变成了有名称的 ride。

branches.en: Bikes and buses both carry a rider.
branches.cn: 自行车与公交车都载着骑乘者。

branches.en: A vehicle trip becomes an experience.
branches.cn: 乘车出行变成一种体验。

intro.en: Ride is an old English verb with a Germanic root.
intro.cn: ride 是带有日耳曼词根的古英语动词。

latinIntro.en: It has no Latin source; Old English ridan is the origin.
latinIntro.cn: 它没有拉丁语来源；古英语 ridan 是起源。

items.example: Ridan is the oldest recorded form.
items.exampleCN: ridan 是现存最古老的形式。
ridden 出现在 debt-ridden 中。
